case_reviews.oracle: Two segmentations retain exactly 65,536 bytes; crossing the limit with a two-byte read keeps both output and seen at 65,535 and consumes no accepted suffix.
case_reviews.boundary: Tests real BoundedHandshakeIo over a scripted AsyncRead, not negotiated TLS ingress.

case_reviews.oracle: Fixed literal eight queue permits, ninth refusal, two active permits, third refusal and reuse after drop.
case_reviews.boundary: In-memory capacity owner; error-only negatives are paired with usable permits and successful reuse.

case_reviews.oracle: A TLS1.3-only server requiring a client certificate accepts all four operations; client decodes exact Unavailable responses and server checks request path.
case_reviews.boundary: Test CA and controlled local producer, not Platform. This server checks the path using Operation::path; separate endpoint-literal test supplies an independent path oracle. Request body is not independently inspected here.

case_reviews.oracle: Literal 64/65 chunks, 8,192/8,193 content length, oversized chunk and malformed status/framing/trailer negatives.
case_reviews.boundary: Chunked positive is 64 bytes, while fixed-length cases independently qualify exact body maximum. No physical network.

case_reviews.oracle: Literal 1,000/2,000/3,000 ms constants, mismatched host/name, excessive root count, invalid client material and a 4,097-byte root are refused.
case_reviews.boundary: The oversized root is all zero and also invalid DER; its refusal is not isolated proof of the size guard. Five-root boundary has a separate 4/5 valid-root test.

case_reviews.oracle: Second activation refuses; after drop eight queue permits can still be acquired and a ninth refuses.
case_reviews.boundary: The final refill checks queued slots, not all active slots. Adjacent two-active/reuse test is distinct.

case_reviews.oracle: A real local mTLS exchange accepts the four-certificate control and rejects changed server name, root, client identity/EKU and a fifth certificate.
case_reviews.boundary: Controlled public test CA/keys; success/error shape of raw exchange, not admission or publication.

case_reviews.oracle: Actual stalled TCP/TLS peers yield Unavailable after the expected lower deadline; server must observe closure within two seconds. Aborting an active client produces EOF.
case_reviews.boundary: System-clock/network test; elapsed lower bounds do not independently cap excessive delay before return. The separate literal constant assertions retain value.

case_reviews.oracle: Unactivated exchange is required to error; after 1,001 ms activation must be Unavailable.
case_reviews.boundary: Inactive exchange uses uncontrolled loopback port 1 and only is_err. A connection failure could satisfy it if require_active were removed; no surviving production mutant was executed.

case_reviews.oracle: Four copies of a valid CA are accepted, five refused.
case_reviews.boundary: Exact root-count boundary, separate from root DER byte bound.

case_reviews.oracle: Two constructed chunk streams differ by one framing byte; exact acceptance/refusal pins inclusion of the final CRLF.
case_reviews.boundary: Read-response parser over duplex; no TLS stack.

case_reviews.oracle: IPv4/IPv6 literals accepted; source.test/localhost refused with otherwise equal descriptor material.
case_reviews.boundary: Descriptor parsing contract, no DNS/network lookup performed by the case.

case_reviews.oracle: Independent valid controls and one malformed header-name, signed length, control-byte or signed chunk-size condition each determine parser success.
case_reviews.boundary: Raw HTTP parser only; all generated bytes are retained in this case body.

case_reviews.oracle: Fixed endpoint and exact version-4 request bytes; TLS producer inspects request path/body and returns golden intent bytes. 404/400 map to Unavailable; wrong source authority maps specifically to InvalidDescriptor.
case_reviews.boundary: Fixture CA and golden intent; not live Platform. Server uses one request read, so its request fixture assumes delivery within that read.

case_reviews.oracle: Each of four explicit operations equals the fixed accepted native-evidence path literal.
case_reviews.boundary: Pure mapping compatibility guard; complements transport loop that uses the same Operation::path on its server side.

case_reviews.oracle: EOF/fixed-length and absent/case-insensitive identity encoding preserve exact decoded Unavailable. 8,192/8,193 EOF bounds, compression/duplicate encoding refusal and truncated JSON decode refusal.
case_reviews.boundary: Parser plus decoder, no source publication or durable floor.

case_reviews.oracle: TLS server sends body without closing, requires request bytes, and sees client close; exchange returns Unavailable after 3,000 ms.
case_reviews.boundary: Real socket deadline case with lower time bound and server-closure timeout.

case_reviews.oracle: Four disabled publication families return Unavailable and the actual nonblocking listener has no accepted connection.
case_reviews.boundary: Production publication_supported checks only the relevant family flags for these snapshot operations; the {} body does not independently refuse them before a connection. No producer/durable acceptance tested.

case_reviews.oracle: Enabled skills publication reaches real mTLS listener at fixed endpoint with close semantics and exact golden body; accepted version-2 ACK maps to Delivery::Accepted.
case_reviews.boundary: One family positive wire case; other families have their own pure activation tests. Local controlled producer, not public deployment.

case_reviews.oracle: Literal capacity values two/eight are checked. SHA constants are checked only for length 40.
case_reviews.boundary: The SHA-length assertions do not validate checkout identity; run.sh and workflow independently compare actual Git objects/revisions.

case_reviews.oracle: All four real queries require Observed provenance (authority, nonzero revision, matching decision and bounded clock uncertainty). Account allow/minimum-generation and exact fresh/recovery key material are checked.
case_reviews.boundary: Explicit ignored topology case; required environment fails rather than silently skips when selected. Depends on pinned external Platform topology and deliberately seeded test account/key facts.

case_reviews.oracle: Actual decoder must observe untrusted fresh key with exact retained public bytes; emits a case marker after this assertion.
case_reviews.boundary: Explicit ignored topology case. Reconciliation/revocation action is performed by run.sh before selection.

case_reviews.oracle: Two threads acquire active permits before a three-party barrier; a third activation must be CapacityExceeded, and both real queries eventually return valid Observed provenance.
case_reviews.boundary: Tests Game-side capacity permits, not independently observed simultaneous HTTP execution. External script holds DB rows temporarily; its producer-side capacity proof is a separate section.

case_reviews.oracle: Only compares Response::Failure(Failure::Unavailable) with the identical constructor expression.
case_reviews.boundary: No production operation, decoder or input varies. This is a tautology beyond compile-time enum availability; propose removal or a concrete codec behavior, held pending source checkpoint.

case_reviews.oracle: Pure length validator accepts four 4,096-byte certificates and refuses a 4,097-byte leaf, oversize fourth, fifth certificate and addition overflow.
case_reviews.boundary: Certificate lengths only, not DER validity or cryptographic chain authentication; complements actual TLS peer boundary tests.

runtime_boundary: No transport or real S3-A case executed in this review. Separate s3a_selector_semantics_probe.json ran a previously built native test binary with a nonexistent exact ignored selector: rc0/0 tests. It proves libtest selection semantics, not a current S3-A no-op or successful topology.

unapplied_findings.fact: Inactive exchange test accepts any error at loopback port 1; actual require_active returns CapacityExceeded before connecting.
unapplied_findings.inference: If the activation check is removed and that endpoint is unavailable, an I/O error still satisfies the assertion.
unapplied_findings.recommendation: Require the exact CapacityExceeded outcome and/or observe no accepted connection on a controlled listener; qualify with guard deletion before editing.

unapplied_findings.fact: The root size negative supplies 4,097 zero bytes. After the size check, RootCertStore::add also maps invalid DER to InvalidDescriptor.
unapplied_findings.inference: This negative has an independent DER rejection cause; it does not isolate the configured-root byte cap.
unapplied_findings.recommendation: Use structurally valid oversize DER or an independently tested length predicate in a qualified follow-up.
Remove the no-behavior case or replace it with a specific input/decoder refusal; preserve the actual transport Unavailable cases.

unapplied_findings.fact: run.sh uses bare Cargo exit status for the selected ignored Rust cases, then emits broader evidence. Actual libtest accepts a nonexistent exact ignored selector with exit0 and zero tests.
unapplied_findings.boundary: All current selector names exist. No actual current S3-A no-op or whole-topology run is claimed.
unapplied_findings.recommendation: Give the S3-A caller the exact selected-case/count/body terminal contract and malformed/zero-selection controls, as separately qualified for S3-B.

unapplied_findings.fact: qualification_pins_are_closed only checks the two SHA string lengths. Actual checkout pins are enforced by shell/workflow Git comparisons.
unapplied_findings.recommendation: Keep literal capacity assertions as a capacity contract; avoid crediting SHA self-length checks as revision qualification.
